achievements.text: Redesigned an asynchronous export pipeline at HiLabs using database cursor streaming, producer-consumer concurrency and parallel I/O, cutting export time from 45 minutes to 2 minutes and eliminating JVM memory constraints.

Designed and implemented a scalable asynchronous audit logging framework at HiLabs using Spring AOP and Kafka, ensuring reliable event delivery through exponential backoff and a Dead Letter Queue while keeping request latency low.

Engineered a schema-per-tenant multi-tenancy architecture at HiLabs using Spring Boot, Hibernate Multi-Tenancy and PostgreSQL, resolving tenant schemas through JWT-based context propagation and ThreadLocal for data isolation.

Built an AI-powered rule management platform at HiLabs on the Model Context Protocol, developing both the MCP Server and MCP Client so business rules could be created, validated, updated and executed from natural language via OpenAI.
Integrated Redis distributed caching at HiLabs to reduce repeated database access and improve throughput across backend services.

Developed HiLabs' core marketing platform in Next.js using SSG, ISR and SSR rendering strategies, integrated HubSpot for user-interaction analytics, and deployed it behind a CDN for sub-1s global page rendering.

Built the R3 provider-address accuracy model, lifting provider-directory accuracy from 54.9% to 75.3% across 2,493 provider-location records by engineering 92 features from Snowflake claims, CMS, NPPES and web evidence, and designing a two-stage LightGBM cascade that reached 0.81/0.94 five-fold CV AUC and 98% precision@200 under a hard 30% phone-verification budget.

Deployed the R3 model as a Dockerized FastAPI inference service with TreeSHAP explanations, SQLite-backed asynchronous job tracking and YAML-driven feature configuration for reproducible model serving.

At Samaritan AI, developed a real-time Python pipeline to process, synchronise and visualise asynchronous multi-sensor telemetry, and engineered Wi-Fi and Bluetooth IoT modules streaming continuous sensor data to backend servers and mobile clients.
At Samaritan AI, built a Python GUI with Tkinter and Matplotlib providing real-time simulation control and automated hourly data visualisation.
Reached 1634 (Expert) on Codeforces and Knight on LeetCode across 40+ competitive programming contests.

Personal project, in progress (not yet complete, not production-deployed): designing and building a real-time multiplayer card game backend in Go. Runs one goroutine per game room, using channels for communication between players within that room. Split into a stateless auth/directory service and horizontally-sharded stateful room-server instances, with etcd used for service discovery so the auth service can resolve which room-server instance is authoritative for a given room ID; etcd leases detect a room-server instance going down. Uses WebSocket ping/pong frames to detect a player disconnecting, pausing the game in memory and resuming it when the player reconnects. Built using test-driven development.
